067        public void initBattle(final BattleCreationContext context, MissionDefinitionAPI loader) {
068
069                this.context = context;
070                this.loader = loader;
071                CampaignFleetAPI playerFleet = context.getPlayerFleet();
072                CampaignFleetAPI otherFleet = context.getOtherFleet();
073                FleetGoal playerGoal = context.getPlayerGoal();
074                FleetGoal enemyGoal = context.getOtherGoal();
075
076                // doesn't work for consecutive engagements; haven't investigated why
077                //Random random = Misc.getRandom(Misc.getNameBasedSeed(otherFleet), 23);
078                
079                Random random = Misc.getRandom(Misc.getSalvageSeed(otherFleet) *
080                                (long)otherFleet.getFleetData().getNumMembers(), 23);
081                //System.out.println("RNG: " + random.nextLong());
082                //random = new Random(1213123L);
083                //Random random = Misc.random;
084                
085                escape = playerGoal == FleetGoal.ESCAPE || enemyGoal == FleetGoal.ESCAPE;
086                
087                int maxFP = (int) Global.getSettings().getFloat("maxNoObjectiveBattleSize");
088                int fpOne = 0;
089                int fpTwo = 0;
090                for (FleetMemberAPI member : playerFleet.getFleetData().getMembersListCopy()) {
091                        if (member.canBeDeployedForCombat() || playerGoal == FleetGoal.ESCAPE) {
092                                fpOne += member.getUnmodifiedDeploymentPointsCost();
093                        }
094                }
095                for (FleetMemberAPI member : otherFleet.getFleetData().getMembersListCopy()) {
096                        if (member.canBeDeployedForCombat() || playerGoal == FleetGoal.ESCAPE) {
097                                fpTwo += member.getUnmodifiedDeploymentPointsCost();
098                        }
099                }
100                
101                int smaller = Math.min(fpOne, fpTwo);
102                
103                boolean withObjectives = smaller > maxFP;
104                //withObjectives = true;
105                if (!context.objectivesAllowed) {
106                        withObjectives = false;
107                } else if (context.forceObjectivesOnMap) {
108                        withObjectives = true;
109                }
110                
111                int numObjectives = 0;
112                if (withObjectives) {
113//                      if (fpOne + fpTwo > maxFP + 70) {
114//                              numObjectives = 3 
115//                              numObjectives = 3 + (int)(Math.random() * 2.0);
116//                      } else {
117//                              numObjectives = 2 + (int)(Math.random() * 2.0);
118//                      }
119                        if (fpOne + fpTwo > maxFP + 70) {
120                                numObjectives = 4;
121                                //numObjectives = 3 + (int)(Math.random() * 2.0);
122                        } else {
123                                numObjectives = 3 + random.nextInt(2);
124                                //numObjectives = 2 + (int)(Math.random() * 2.0);
125                        }
126                }
127                
128                // shouldn't be possible, but..
129                if (numObjectives > 4) {
130                        numObjectives = 4;
131                }
132                
133                int baseCommandPoints = (int) Global.getSettings().getFloat("startingCommandPoints");
134
135                // 
136                loader.initFleet(FleetSide.PLAYER, "ISS", playerGoal, false,
137                                context.getPlayerCommandPoints() - baseCommandPoints,
138                                (int) playerFleet.getCommanderStats().getCommandPoints().getModifiedValue() - baseCommandPoints);
139                loader.initFleet(FleetSide.ENEMY, "", enemyGoal, true, 
140                                (int) otherFleet.getCommanderStats().getCommandPoints().getModifiedValue() - baseCommandPoints);
141
142                List<FleetMemberAPI> playerShips = playerFleet.getFleetData().getCombatReadyMembersListCopy();
143                if (playerGoal == FleetGoal.ESCAPE) {
144                        playerShips = playerFleet.getFleetData().getMembersListCopy();
145                }
146                for (FleetMemberAPI member : playerShips) {
147                        loader.addFleetMember(FleetSide.PLAYER, member);
148                }
149                
150                
151                List<FleetMemberAPI> enemyShips = otherFleet.getFleetData().getCombatReadyMembersListCopy();
152                if (enemyGoal == FleetGoal.ESCAPE) {
153                        enemyShips = otherFleet.getFleetData().getMembersListCopy();
154                }
155                for (FleetMemberAPI member : enemyShips) {
156                        loader.addFleetMember(FleetSide.ENEMY, member);
157                }
158                
159                width = 18000f;
160                height = 18000f;
161                
162                if (escape) {
163                        width = 18000f;
164                        //height = 24000f;
165                        height = 18000f;
166                } else if (withObjectives) {
167                        width = 24000f;
168                        if (numObjectives == 2) {
169                                height = 14000f;
170                        } else {
171                                height = 18000f;
172                        }
173                }
174                
175                width += context.extraMapWidth;
176                height += context.extraMapHeight;
177                
178                createMap(random);
179                
180                context.setInitialDeploymentBurnDuration(1.5f);
181                context.setNormalDeploymentBurnDuration(6f);
182                context.setEscapeDeploymentBurnDuration(1.5f);
183                
184                xPad = 2000f;
185                yPad = 3000f;
186                
187                if (escape) {
188//                      addEscapeObjectives(loader, 4);
189//                      context.setInitialEscapeRange(7000f);
190//                      context.setFlankDeploymentDistance(9000f);
191                        addEscapeObjectives(loader, 2, random);
192//                      context.setInitialEscapeRange(4000f);
193//                      context.setFlankDeploymentDistance(8000f);
194
195                        context.setInitialEscapeRange(Global.getSettings().getFloat("escapeStartDistance"));
196                        context.setFlankDeploymentDistance(Global.getSettings().getFloat("escapeFlankDistance"));
197                        
198                        loader.addPlugin(new EscapeRevealPlugin(context));
199                } else {
200                        if (withObjectives) {
201                                addObjectives(loader, numObjectives, random);
202                                context.setStandoffRange(height - 4500f);
203                        } else {
204                                context.setStandoffRange(6000f);
205                        }
206                        
207                        context.setFlankDeploymentDistance(height/2f); // matters for Force Concentration
208                }
209        }

211        public void afterDefinitionLoad(final CombatEngineAPI engine) {
212                if (coronaIntensity > 0 && (corona != null || pulsar != null)) {
213                        String name = "Corona";
214                        if (pulsar != null) name = pulsar.getTerrainName();
215                        else if (corona != null) name = corona.getTerrainName();
216                        
217                        final String name2 = name;
218                        
219//                      CombatFleetManagerAPI manager = engine.getFleetManager(FleetSide.PLAYER);
220//                      for (FleetMemberAPI member : manager.getReservesCopy()) {
221//                      }
222                        final Object key1 = new Object();
223                        final Object key2 = new Object();
224                        final String icon = Global.getSettings().getSpriteName("ui", "icon_tactical_cr_penalty");
225                        engine.addPlugin(new BaseEveryFrameCombatPlugin() {
226                                @Override
227                                public void advance(float amount, List<InputEventAPI> events) {
228                                        engine.maintainStatusForPlayerShip(key1, icon, name2, "reduced peak time", true);
229                                        engine.maintainStatusForPlayerShip(key2, icon, name2, "faster CR degradation", true);
230                                }
231                        });
232                }
233                
234                if (abyssalDepth > 0) {
235                        Color color = Misc.scaleColor(Color.white, 1f - abyssalDepth);
236                        engine.setBackgroundColor(color);
237
238                        color = Misc.scaleAlpha(Color.black, abyssalDepth * ABYSS_OVERLAY_ALPHA);
239                        engine.setBackgroundGlowColor(color);
240                        engine.setBackgroundGlowColorNonAdditive(true);
241                        
242                        if (abyssalDepth > HyperspaceAbyssPluginImpl.DEPTH_THRESHOLD_FOR_NO_DUST_PARTICLES_IN_COMBAT) {
243                                engine.setRenderStarfield(false);
244                        }
245                        
246                        final Object key1 = new Object();
247                        final Object key2 = new Object();
248                        final String icon = Global.getSettings().getSpriteName("ui", "icon_tactical_engine_damage");
249                        final String name = "Abyssal hyperspace";
250                        engine.addPlugin(new BaseEveryFrameCombatPlugin() {
251                                @Override
252                                public void advance(float amount, List<InputEventAPI> events) {
253                                        String percentSpeed = "-" + (int)Math.round(ABYSS_SHIP_SPEED_PENALTY) + "%";
254                                        String percentMissile = "-" + (int)Math.round(ABYSS_MISSILE_SPEED_PENALTY) + "%";
255                                        engine.maintainStatusForPlayerShip(key1, icon, name, percentSpeed + " top speed", true);
256                                        engine.maintainStatusForPlayerShip(key2, icon, name, percentMissile + " missle speed / range", true);
257                                        
258                                        String modId = "abyssal";
259                                        float modW = -0.0f * abyssalDepth;
260                                        float modL = -0.33f * abyssalDepth;
261                                        float modG = -0.5f * abyssalDepth;
262                                        
263                                        for (ShipAPI curr : engine.getShips()) {
264                                                if (curr.isHulk()) continue;
265                                                
266                                                curr.getEngineController().fadeToOtherColor(this, Color.black, null, 1f, abyssalDepth * 0.4f);
267                                                curr.getEngineController().extendFlame(this, modL, modW, modG);
268                                                
269                                                curr.getMutableStats().getMaxSpeed().modifyMult(modId, 
270                                                                                        1f - abyssalDepth * ABYSS_SHIP_SPEED_PENALTY * 0.01f);
271                                                curr.getMutableStats().getMissileWeaponRangeBonus().modifyMult(modId, 
272                                                                                        1f - abyssalDepth * ABYSS_MISSILE_SPEED_PENALTY * 0.01f);
273                                                curr.getMutableStats().getMissileMaxSpeedBonus().modifyMult(modId,
274                                                                                        1f - abyssalDepth * ABYSS_MISSILE_SPEED_PENALTY * 0.01f);
275                                        }
276                                        
277                                        for (MissileAPI missile : engine.getMissiles()) {
278                                                missile.getEngineController().fadeToOtherColor(this, Color.black, null, 1f, abyssalDepth * 0.4f);
279                                                missile.getEngineController().extendFlame(this, modL, modW, 0f);
280                                        }
281                                                
282                                }
283                        });
284                        
285                }
286        }

289        protected float abyssalDepth = 0f;
290        protected float coronaIntensity = 0f;
291        protected StarCoronaTerrainPlugin corona = null;
292        protected PulsarBeamTerrainPlugin pulsar = null;
293        protected void createMap(Random random) {
294                loader.initMap((float)-width/2f, (float)width/2f, (float)-height/2f, (float)height/2f);
295                
296                CampaignFleetAPI playerFleet = context.getPlayerFleet();
297                String nebulaTex = null;
298                String nebulaMapTex = null;
299                boolean inNebula = false;
300
301                boolean protectedFromCorona = false;
302                for (CustomCampaignEntityAPI curr : playerFleet.getContainingLocation().getCustomEntitiesWithTag(Tags.PROTECTS_FROM_CORONA_IN_BATTLE)) {
303                        if (Misc.getDistance(curr.getLocation(), playerFleet.getLocation()) <= curr.getRadius() + Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet().getRadius() + 10f) {
304                                protectedFromCorona = true;
305                                break;
306                        }
307                }
308                
309                abyssalDepth = Misc.getAbyssalDepth(playerFleet);
310                
311                float numRings = 0;
312                
313                Color coronaColor = null;
314                // this assumes that all nebula in a system are of the same color
315                for (CampaignTerrainAPI terrain : playerFleet.getContainingLocation().getTerrainCopy()) {
316                        //if (terrain.getType().equals(Terrain.NEBULA)) {
317                        if (terrain.getPlugin() instanceof NebulaTextureProvider) {
318                                if (terrain.getPlugin().containsEntity(playerFleet)) {
319                                        inNebula = true;
320                                        if (terrain.getPlugin() instanceof NebulaTextureProvider) {
321                                                NebulaTextureProvider provider = (NebulaTextureProvider) terrain.getPlugin();
322                                                nebulaTex = provider.getNebulaTex();
323                                                nebulaMapTex = provider.getNebulaMapTex();
324                                        }
325                                } else {
326                                        if (nebulaTex == null) {
327                                                if (terrain.getPlugin() instanceof NebulaTextureProvider) {
328                                                        NebulaTextureProvider provider = (NebulaTextureProvider) terrain.getPlugin();
329                                                        nebulaTex = provider.getNebulaTex();
330                                                        nebulaMapTex = provider.getNebulaMapTex();
331                                                }       
332                                        }
333                                }
334                        } else if (terrain.getPlugin() instanceof StarCoronaTerrainPlugin && pulsar == null && !protectedFromCorona) {
335                                StarCoronaTerrainPlugin plugin = (StarCoronaTerrainPlugin) terrain.getPlugin();
336                                if (plugin.containsEntity(playerFleet)) {
337                                        float angle = Misc.getAngleInDegrees(terrain.getLocation(), playerFleet.getLocation());
338                                        Color color = plugin.getAuroraColorForAngle(angle);
339                                        float intensity = plugin.getIntensityAtPoint(playerFleet.getLocation());
340                                        intensity = 0.4f + 0.6f * intensity;
341                                        int alpha = (int)(80f * intensity);
342                                        color = Misc.setAlpha(color, alpha);
343                                        if (coronaColor == null || coronaColor.getAlpha() < alpha) {
344                                                coronaColor = color;
345                                                coronaIntensity = intensity;
346                                                corona = plugin;
347                                        }
348                                }
349                        } else if (terrain.getPlugin() instanceof PulsarBeamTerrainPlugin && !protectedFromCorona) {
350                                PulsarBeamTerrainPlugin plugin = (PulsarBeamTerrainPlugin) terrain.getPlugin();
351                                if (plugin.containsEntity(playerFleet)) {
352                                        float angle = Misc.getAngleInDegreesStrict(terrain.getLocation(), playerFleet.getLocation());
353                                        Color color = plugin.getPulsarColorForAngle(angle);
354                                        float intensity = plugin.getIntensityAtPoint(playerFleet.getLocation());
355                                        intensity = 0.4f + 0.6f * intensity;
356                                        int alpha = (int)(80f * intensity);
357                                        color = Misc.setAlpha(color, alpha);
358                                        if (coronaColor == null || coronaColor.getAlpha() < alpha) {
359                                                coronaColor = color;
360                                                coronaIntensity = intensity;
361                                                pulsar = plugin;
362                                                corona = null;
363                                        }
364                                }
365                        } else if (terrain.getType().equals(Terrain.RING)) {
366                                if (terrain.getPlugin().containsEntity(playerFleet)) {
367                                        numRings++;
368                                }
369                        }
370                }
371                if (nebulaTex != null) {
372                        loader.setNebulaTex(nebulaTex);
373                        loader.setNebulaMapTex(nebulaMapTex);
374                }
375                
376                if (coronaColor != null) {
377                        loader.setBackgroundGlowColor(coronaColor);
378                }
379                
380                int numNebula = 15;
381                if (inNebula) {
382                        numNebula = 100;
383                }
384                if (!inNebula && playerFleet.isInHyperspace()) {
385                        numNebula = 0;
386                }
387                
388                for (int i = 0; i < numNebula; i++) {
389                        float x = random.nextFloat() * width - width/2;
390                        float y = random.nextFloat() * height - height/2;
391                        float radius = 100f + random.nextFloat() * 400f;
392                        if (inNebula) {
393                                radius += 100f + 500f * random.nextFloat();
394                        }
395                        loader.addNebula(x, y, radius);
396                }
397                
398                if (!playerFleet.isInHyperspace()) {
399                        float numAsteroidsWithinRange = countNearbyAsteroids(playerFleet);
400                        
401                        int numAsteroids = Math.min(400, (int)((numAsteroidsWithinRange + 1f) * 20f));
402                        
403                        loader.addAsteroidField(0, 0, random.nextFloat() * 360f, width,
404                                                                        20f, 70f, numAsteroids);
405                        
406                        if (numRings > 0) {
407                                int numRingAsteroids = (int) (numRings * 300 + (numRings * 600f) * random.nextFloat());
408                                //int numRingAsteroids = (int) (numRings * 1600 + (numRings * 600f) * (float) Math.random());
409                                if (numRingAsteroids > 1500) {
410                                        numRingAsteroids = 1500;
411                                }
412                                loader.addRingAsteroids(0, 0, random.nextFloat() * 360f, width,
413                                                100f, 200f, numRingAsteroids);
414                        }
415                }
416                
417                //setRandomBackground(loader);
418                loader.setBackgroundSpriteName(playerFleet.getContainingLocation().getBackgroundTextureFilename());
419//              loader.setBackgroundSpriteName("graphics/backgrounds/hyperspace_bg_cool.jpg");
420//              loader.setBackgroundSpriteName("graphics/ships/onslaught/onslaught_base.png");
421
422                if (playerFleet.getContainingLocation() == Global.getSector().getHyperspace()) {
423                        loader.setHyperspaceMode(true);
424                } else {
425                        loader.setHyperspaceMode(false);
426                }
427                
428                //addMultiplePlanets();
429                addClosestPlanet();
430        }

432        protected void addClosestPlanet() {
433                float bgWidth = 2048f;
434                float bgHeight = 2048f;
435                
436                PlanetAPI planet = getClosestPlanet(context.getPlayerFleet());
437                if (planet == null) return;
438                
439                float dist = Vector2f.sub(context.getPlayerFleet().getLocation(), planet.getLocation(), new Vector2f()).length() - planet.getRadius();
440                if (dist < 0) dist = 0;
441                float baseRadius = planet.getRadius();
442                float scaleFactor = 1.5f;
443                float maxRadius = 500f;
444                float minRadius = 100f;
445                                
446//              if (planet.isStar()) {
447//                      scaleFactor = 0.01f;
448//                      maxRadius = 20f;
449//              }
450                
451                float maxDist = SINGLE_PLANET_MAX_DIST - planet.getRadius();
452                if (maxDist < 1) maxDist = 1;
453                
454                
455                boolean playerHasStation = false;
456                boolean enemyHasStation = false;
457                
458                for (FleetMemberAPI curr : context.getPlayerFleet().getFleetData().getMembersListCopy()) {
459                        if (curr.isStation()) {
460                                playerHasStation = true;
461                                break;
462                        }
463                }
464                
465                for (FleetMemberAPI curr : context.getOtherFleet().getFleetData().getMembersListCopy()) {
466                        if (curr.isStation()) {
467                                enemyHasStation = true;
468                                break;
469                        }
470                }
471                
472                float planetYOffset = 0;
473                
474                if (playerHasStation) {
475                        planetYOffset = -bgHeight / 2f * 0.5f;
476                }
477                if (enemyHasStation) {
478                        planetYOffset = bgHeight / 2f * 0.5f;
479                }
480                
481                
482                float f = (maxDist - dist) / maxDist * 0.65f + 0.35f;
483                float radius = baseRadius * f * scaleFactor;
484                if (radius > maxRadius) radius = maxRadius;
485                if (radius < minRadius) radius = minRadius;
486                loader.setPlanetBgSize(bgWidth * f, bgHeight * f);
487                loader.addPlanet(0f, planetYOffset, radius, planet, 0f, true);
488        }
489        
490        protected void addMultiplePlanets() {
491                float bgWidth = 2048f;
492                float bgHeight = 2048f;
493                loader.setPlanetBgSize(bgWidth, bgHeight);
494                
495                
496                List<NearbyPlanetData> planets = getNearbyPlanets(context.getPlayerFleet());
497                if (!planets.isEmpty()) {
498                        float maxDist = PLANET_MAX_DIST;
499                        for (NearbyPlanetData data : planets) {
500                                float dist = Vector2f.sub(context.getPlayerFleet().getLocation(), data.planet.getLocation(), new Vector2f()).length();
501                                float baseRadius = data.planet.getRadius();
502                                float scaleFactor = 1.5f;
503                                float maxRadius = 500f;
504                                
505                                if (data.planet.isStar()) {
506                                        // skip stars in combat, bright and annoying
507                                        continue;
508//                                      scaleFactor = 0.1f;
509//                                      maxRadius = 50f;
510                                }
511                                
512                                float f = (maxDist - dist) / maxDist * 0.65f + 0.35f;
513                                float radius = baseRadius * f * scaleFactor;
514                                if (radius > maxRadius) radius = maxRadius;
515                                
516                                loader.addPlanet(data.offset.x * bgWidth / PLANET_AREA_WIDTH * scaleFactor,
517                                                                 data.offset.y * bgHeight / PLANET_AREA_HEIGHT * scaleFactor,
518                                                                 radius, data.planet.getTypeId(), 0f, true);
519                        }
520                        
521                }
522        }

541        protected void addObjectives(MissionDefinitionAPI loader, int num, Random random) {
542                //if (true) return;
543                
544                objs = new ArrayList<String>(Arrays.asList(new String [] {
545                                SENSOR,
546                                SENSOR,
547                                NAV,
548                                NAV,
549                                //COMM,
550                                //COMM,
551                }));
552
553                if (num == 2) { // minimum is 3 now, so this shouldn't happen
554                        objs = new ArrayList<String>(Arrays.asList(new String [] {
555                                        SENSOR,
556                                        SENSOR,
557                                        NAV,
558                                        NAV,
559                                        COMM,
560                        }));
561                        addObjectiveAt(0.25f, 0.5f, 0f, 0f, random);
562                        addObjectiveAt(0.75f, 0.5f, 0f, 0f, random);
563                } else if (num == 3) {
564                        float r = random.nextFloat();
565                        if (r < 0.33f) {
566                                addObjectiveAt(0.25f, 0.7f, 1f, 1f, random);
567                                addObjectiveAt(0.25f, 0.3f, 1f, 1f, random);
568                                addObjectiveAt(0.75f, 0.5f, 1f, 1f, COMM, random);
569                        } else if (r < 0.67f) {
570                                addObjectiveAt(0.75f, 0.7f, 1f, 1f, random);
571                                addObjectiveAt(0.75f, 0.3f, 1f, 1f, random);
572                                addObjectiveAt(0.25f, 0.5f, 1f, 1f, COMM, random);
573                        } else {
574                                if (random.nextFloat() < 0.5f) {
575                                        addObjectiveAt(0.22f, 0.7f, 1f, 1f, random);
576                                        addObjectiveAt(0.5f, 0.5f, 1f, 1f, COMM, random);
577                                        addObjectiveAt(0.78f, 0.3f, 1f, 1f, random);
578                                } else {
579                                        addObjectiveAt(0.22f, 0.3f, 1f, 1f, random);
580                                        addObjectiveAt(0.5f, 0.5f, 1f, 1f, COMM, random);
581                                        addObjectiveAt(0.78f, 0.7f, 1f, 1f, random);
582                                }
583                        }
584                } else if (num == 4) {
585                        float r = random.nextFloat();
586                        if (r < 0.33f) {
587                                String [] maybeRelays = pickCommRelays(2, 2, false, true, true, false, random);
588                                addObjectiveAt(0.25f, 0.25f, 2f, 1f, maybeRelays[0], random);
589                                addObjectiveAt(0.25f, 0.75f, 2f, 1f, maybeRelays[1], random);
590                                addObjectiveAt(0.75f, 0.25f, 2f, 1f, maybeRelays[2], random);
591                                addObjectiveAt(0.75f, 0.75f, 2f, 1f, maybeRelays[3], random);
592                        } else if (r < 0.67f) {
593                                String [] maybeRelays = pickCommRelays(1, 2, true, false, true, false, random);
594                                addObjectiveAt(0.25f, 0.5f, 1f, 1f, maybeRelays[0], random);
595                                addObjectiveAt(0.5f, 0.75f, 1f, 1f, maybeRelays[1], random);
596                                addObjectiveAt(0.75f, 0.5f, 1f, 1f, maybeRelays[2], random);
597                                addObjectiveAt(0.5f, 0.25f, 1f, 1f, maybeRelays[3], random);
598                        } else {
599                                if (random.nextFloat() < 0.5f) {
600                                        String [] maybeRelays = pickCommRelays(1, 2, true, false, true, false, random);
601                                        addObjectiveAt(0.25f, 0.25f, 1f, 0f, maybeRelays[0], random);
602                                        addObjectiveAt(0.4f, 0.6f, 1f, 0f, maybeRelays[1], random);
603                                        addObjectiveAt(0.6f, 0.4f, 1f, 0f, maybeRelays[2], random);
604                                        addObjectiveAt(0.75f, 0.75f, 1f, 0f, maybeRelays[3], random);
605                                } else {
606                                        String [] maybeRelays = pickCommRelays(1, 2, false, true, false, true, random);
607                                        addObjectiveAt(0.25f, 0.75f, 1f, 0f, maybeRelays[0], random);
608                                        addObjectiveAt(0.4f, 0.4f, 1f, 0f, maybeRelays[1], random);
609                                        addObjectiveAt(0.6f, 0.6f, 1f, 0f, maybeRelays[2], random);
610                                        addObjectiveAt(0.75f, 0.25f, 1f, 0f, maybeRelays[3], random);
611                                }
612                        }
613                }
614        }

616        protected String [] pickCommRelays(int min, int max, boolean comm1, boolean comm2, boolean comm3, boolean comm4, Random random) {
617                String [] result = new String [4];
618                
619                WeightedRandomPicker<Integer> picker = new WeightedRandomPicker<Integer>(random);
620                if (comm1) picker.add(0);
621                if (comm2) picker.add(1);
622                if (comm3) picker.add(2);
623                if (comm4) picker.add(3);
624                
625                int num = min + random.nextInt(max - min + 1);
626                
627                for (int i = 0; i < num && !picker.isEmpty(); i++) {
628                        result[picker.pickAndRemove()] = COMM;
629                }
630                return result;
631        }

660                                addObjectiveAt(0.75f, 0.5f, 1f, 6f, random);

663                                addObjectiveAt(0.75f, 0.75f, 1f, 1f, random);

668                                addObjectiveAt(0.5f, 0.75f, 4f, 1f, random);

691        protected void addObjectiveAt(float xMult, float yMult, float xOff, float yOff, Random random) {
692                addObjectiveAt(xMult, yMult, xOff, yOff, null, random);
693        }
694        protected void addObjectiveAt(float xMult, float yMult, float xOff, float yOff, String type, Random random) {
695                //String type = pickAny();
696                if (type == null) {
697                        type = pickAny(random);
698                        if (objs != null && objs.size() > 0) {
699                                int index = (int) (random.nextDouble() * objs.size());
700                                type = objs.remove(index); 
701                        }
702                }
703                
704                float minX = -width/2 + xPad;
705                float minY = -height/2 + yPad;
706                
707                float x = (width - xPad * 2f) * xMult + minX;
708                float y = (height - yPad * 2f) * yMult + minY;
709                
710                x = ((int) x / 1000) * 1000f;
711                y = ((int) y / 1000) * 1000f;
712                
713                float offsetX = Math.round((random.nextFloat() - 0.5f) * xOff * 1f) * 1000f;
714                float offsetY = Math.round((random.nextFloat() - 0.5f) * yOff * 1f) * 1000f;
715                
716//              offsetX = 0;
717//              offsetY = 0;
718                
719                float xDir = (float) Math.signum(offsetX);
720                float yDir = (float) Math.signum(offsetY);
721                
722                if (xDir == prevXDir && xOff > 0) {
723                        xDir = -xDir;
724                        offsetX = Math.abs(offsetX) * -prevXDir;
725                }
726                
727                if (yDir == prevYDir && yOff > 0) {
728                        yDir = -yDir;
729                        offsetY = Math.abs(offsetY) * -prevYDir;
730                }
731                
732                prevXDir = xDir;
733                prevYDir = yDir;
734                
735                x += offsetX;
736                y += offsetY;
737                
738                loader.addObjective(x, y, type);
739                
740                if (random.nextFloat() > 0.6f && loader.hasNebula()) {
741                        float nebulaSize = random.nextFloat() * 1500f + 500f;
742                        loader.addNebula(x, y, nebulaSize);
743                }
744        }

746        protected String pickAny(Random random) {
747                float r = random.nextFloat();
748                if (r < 0.33f) return "nav_buoy";
749                else if (r < 0.67f) return "sensor_array";
750                else return "comm_relay"; 
751        }

753        protected float countNearbyAsteroids(CampaignFleetAPI playerFleet) {
754                float numAsteroidsWithinRange = 0;
755                LocationAPI loc = playerFleet.getContainingLocation();
756                if (loc instanceof StarSystemAPI) {
757                        StarSystemAPI system = (StarSystemAPI) loc;
758                        List<SectorEntityToken> asteroids = system.getAsteroids();
759                        for (SectorEntityToken asteroid : asteroids) {
760                                float range = Vector2f.sub(playerFleet.getLocation(), asteroid.getLocation(), new Vector2f()).length();
761                                if (range < 300) numAsteroidsWithinRange ++;
762                        }
763                }
764                return numAsteroidsWithinRange;
765        }

767        protected static class NearbyPlanetData {
768                protected Vector2f offset;
769                protected PlanetAPI planet;
770                public NearbyPlanetData(Vector2f offset, PlanetAPI planet) {
771                        this.offset = offset;
772                        this.planet = planet;
773                }
774        }
775        
776        protected static float PLANET_AREA_WIDTH = 2000;
777        protected static float PLANET_AREA_HEIGHT = 2000;
778        protected static float PLANET_MAX_DIST = (float) Math.sqrt(PLANET_AREA_WIDTH/2f * PLANET_AREA_WIDTH/2f + PLANET_AREA_HEIGHT/2f * PLANET_AREA_WIDTH/2f);
779        
780        protected static float SINGLE_PLANET_MAX_DIST = 1000f;
781        
782        protected List<NearbyPlanetData> getNearbyPlanets(CampaignFleetAPI playerFleet) {
783                LocationAPI loc = playerFleet.getContainingLocation();
784                List<NearbyPlanetData> result = new ArrayList<NearbyPlanetData>();
785                if (loc instanceof StarSystemAPI) {
786                        StarSystemAPI system = (StarSystemAPI) loc;
787                        List<PlanetAPI> planets = system.getPlanets();
788                        for (PlanetAPI planet : planets) {
789                                float diffX = planet.getLocation().x - playerFleet.getLocation().x;
790                                float diffY = planet.getLocation().y - playerFleet.getLocation().y;
791                                
792                                if (Math.abs(diffX) < PLANET_AREA_WIDTH/2f && Math.abs(diffY) < PLANET_AREA_HEIGHT/2f) {
793                                        result.add(new NearbyPlanetData(new Vector2f(diffX, diffY), planet));
794                                }
795                        }
796                }
797                return result;
798        }
799        
800        protected PlanetAPI getClosestPlanet(CampaignFleetAPI playerFleet) {
801                LocationAPI loc = playerFleet.getContainingLocation();
802                PlanetAPI closest = null;
803                float minDist = Float.MAX_VALUE;
804                if (loc instanceof StarSystemAPI) {
805                        StarSystemAPI system = (StarSystemAPI) loc;
806                        List<PlanetAPI> planets = system.getPlanets();
807                        for (PlanetAPI planet : planets) {
808                                if (planet.isStar()) continue;
809                                if (Planets.PLANET_LAVA.equals(planet.getTypeId())) continue;
810                                if (Planets.PLANET_LAVA_MINOR.equals(planet.getTypeId())) continue;
811                                if (planet.getSpec().isDoNotShowInCombat()) continue;
812                                
813                                float dist = Vector2f.sub(context.getPlayerFleet().getLocation(), planet.getLocation(), new Vector2f()).length();
814                                if (dist < minDist && dist < SINGLE_PLANET_MAX_DIST) {
815                                        closest = planet;
816                                        minDist = dist;
817                                }
818                        }
819                }
820                return closest;
821        }
